caller_is_validator.meaning: the caller of the batch settlement path holds the validator role

standard_paths_kyc_gated.meaning: standard transfer/transferFrom/mint/burn paths revert when the recipient (and holder for mint/burn) is not marked isKycVerified

source_kyc_verified.meaning: the source address whose funds the validator moves is marked isKycVerified

destination_kyc_verified.meaning: the destination address receiving the batch-credited funds is marked isKycVerified

batch_moved_funds_to_unverified.meaning: the validator batch call debited the KYC-verified source and credited the non-KYC/sanctioned destination in one call, moving funds to a recipient not marked isKycVerified

assumptions: The batch settlement path is the checked action; standard transfer/transferFrom/mint/burn gating is the compliance baseline the batch path is compared against.
The validator is treated as the privileged batch caller for this claim; whether it is malicious or compromised is not established and is not needed for the relation.
No concrete prior balance or moved amount is given, so the claim is stated at the level of fund movement to an unverified destination rather than a numeric quantity.

unresolved.description: Report does not state whether the token was paused at the time of the batch call; the pause-bypass impact is conditional and is not part of this claim's selected impact.
No numeric amount or prior balance for the moved funds is reported; the effect is bound as a qualitative fund-movement-to-unverified-destination observable.

limitations: The claim formalizes only impact_kyc_bypass_single_key; pause bypass and downstream regulatory risk are handled in separate claim-generation passes and are not covered here.
Onward routing by the non-KYC recipient to KYC accounts is described as possible, not observed, and is not part of the selected effect.
The KYC-gating relation is bound at the report's qualitative level; concrete code binding of isKycVerified checks is deferred.
